# 13th Age 2e

13th Age is a heroic fantasy tabletop role-playing game designed by Rob Heinsoo and Jonathan Tweet, both renowned for their work as head designers on different editions of the oldest tabletop RPG (you know which). This game combines the best aspects of traditional RPGs with innovative mechanics that emphasize storytelling and player creativity. Heinsoo and Tweet's design encourages collaborative world-building and dynamic combat, making 13th Age a unique and engaging experience for both new and veteran players.

This sheet was built to keep the story moving. The sheet takes care of the math, the modifiers, and the bookkeeping.

## The escalation die

Set the escalation die in the Turn Tracker and every attack and power roll picks it up automatically, and shows it in the roll breakdown.

## Magic items Automation

Choose an item's type and tier, mark it worn, and its bonus is added into AC, PD, MD, initiative, recoveries, skills, or attacks. Attunement is counted for you, including items above your tier taking two slots.

## One-use items Automation

Activate a consumable and its bonus applies to your rolls. Deactivate it and it is gone.

## Icons, advantages, and twists

Roll all of your icon relationships in a single click. The sheet counts advantages for each icon and raises a twist when an icon gives you nothing.

## Level up Automation

Incremental advances are laid out for you, with the automated ones highlighted. Change your level and hit points, defenses, initiative, attacks, recoveries, and magic item limits all update together.

## Monsters Automatic Scaling

Switch to Monster mode, pick a level and strength, and defenses, hit points, and attack bonuses fill in from the 13th Age monster tables.
